4. I have considered the length of detention as the petitioner is behind bars for 100 days and as charge sheet has not been submitted.
5. Petition is thus allowed.
6. The petitioner is enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/-, with a suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Kokrajhar, under the conditions that- i) the petitioner shall not go near the vicinity of the victim, and ii) the petitioner shall not exercise threats to the witnesses.
On breach of any of the bail conditions, bail order shall stand cancelled.
7. Bail Application stands disposed of.
